svg.text: Outdoor Scene Reconstruction — Workflow and Human Gates
Monocular video → editable, metric-scale 3D scene. Automatic steps run between gates; the driver stops at every gate and waits for you.
camera, depth, and which way is up
already-run steps only; cached cutouts skip
before the most expensive step: generation
• Review sheet: one tile per candidate
• Reuse table: one row per mesh, and who shares it
• or make the same choices in the web decision desk
• solo / shared: own mesh, or one for the class
• reuse group: split a word into look-alike groups
• change class: the label moves, the mask stays
• change image: use another frame of the object
• every instance gets its own mesh (solo)
• shared only where you say so
e.g. a recalled object of a split
already-run steps only; cached cutouts skip
objects SAM3 missed, found again by WildDet3D
• Recall check: each recovered object on the photo
• Verdict table: every candidate, kept or why not
• After-recall sheet: recalled tiles last, yellow
• same fields as Gate 2, except change image
WHICH CLASS A RECALLED OBJECT JOINS
1 word already decided → inherits that decision
2 word never seen before → solo, flagged yellow
3 word split into groups → stop until you pick one
• the pre-recall sheet is kept; delete the
after-recall decisions to return to it
Any step that fails stops the run in place; the next run restarts that segment and skips steps that already finished.
Driver: drive.py --scene <scene> --run <run>, add --go to pass a gate. Sources: drive.py (SEGMENTS, apply_decisions), tools/review_gate.py.
